text:
Rory: Quick heads-up — we're reordering the demo and slides, might need a 20–30s pause to sync. Recorder missed ~90s in rehearsal, can ops confirm fallback?
Maya: On it. OBS encoder showed a small spike (4% drops). Switching to secondary ingest and spinning up local backup recorder now.
DeployBot: ingest-fallback deployed to obs-node-3 :white_check_mark:
Liam: Can we hold stage for ~30s to confirm captions and slide sync? Slides jumped when we switched presenter during rehearsal.
Aria: Quick Q for Mia — will the Dedicated autoscaler still be on the roadmap slide? Folks in product sync asked if we should call it out in Q&A.
Mia (CEO): Yes, we'll keep the autoscaler bullet but mark it as "in design" for Q2. We'll do a brief callout in the roadmap segment and save 5–7 mins for questions. Thanks for flagging the stream issue.
Maya: Running this to start local capture:
```
recorderctl start --session allhands-2026 --path /mnt/recordings/allhands-2026-03-23.mp4 --fallback obs-node-3
```
RecorderBot: Local recorder started: /mnt/recordings/allhands-2026-03-23.mp4 (recording_id: rb-8842)
Rory: Nice. Liam — please bump the captions check to the top of the post-handoff checklist.
Liam: Done. Also will trim the first clean 10m and upload a highlight clip after the meeting.
Aria: Also for Q&A: reserve a slot to answer Dedicated pricing/commit questions — customers keep asking about monthly vs annual commit flexibility.
Mia (CEO): Good idea. We'll handle pricing questions right after the roadmap. @Product please have a PM ready to answer specifics.
Maya: Action created: INF-542 to attach raw recording + notes and link to the trimmed clip when ready. Will ping thread when upload finishes.
Rory: :thumbsup: Ok teams — moving to live. If anyone sees drops, ping me and Maya immediately.
Liam: Seeing smooth feed now. Captions re-synced.
Aria: Thanks — will consolidate Qs and surface top 3 for leadership at the end.
Mia (CEO): Perfect. Appreciate the quick ops response everyone.
Maya: Upload in progress, ETA ~6 mins.
RecorderBot: Upload complete: https://internal-storage/recs/allhands-2026-03-23.mp4 :rocket:
Rory: Thanks — post-meeting follow-ups: Maya to attach INF ticket, Liam to produce 10m clip, Aria to send prioritized Q list to Mia.
Maya: Noted.
Liam: On it.
Aria: Sending Qs in 20m.
Rory: Closing thread and moving to live audio. Good luck :slightly_smiling_face:
